Title: TOM: Q: DS: Kostantin, Baro of the Caravan (Ravnos)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Tom,

Kostantin can take a (D) action to steal equipment from any other minion
as a +1 stealth action.

Can he "steal" equipment from a minion controlled by his own controller,
thereby making the (D) action an unblockable version of "Transfer Equipment"
(with a max of one peice of equipment, of course)?

While you're at it (tom), how abouth Tara, The Hollow One (Mage)? She makes
Ravnos eat their equipment (burn it and gain blood=cost) as a (D) action, and
is also a Ravnos ally. Is she meant to expand your own equipment usage
options, or act as a minor hoser to other Ravnos players? JIC it isn't clear
the question is: Can Tara target one of your own Ravnos as an unblockable (D)
action? ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
Should be: equipment controlled by one of your own Ravnos

gnfnrf

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Kostantin's and Tara's actions are both (D) actions, so may not be
directed against one of your minions.
